info.title: Config_Operation
info.description: RESTful interface for AOS-CX switch software

additional_processing.description: Specify additional information results obtained from config operation execution.

ccf.description: CCF data results when config operation was executed.

diff_mode.description: Used for diff operations to use an alternate diff mode

attempts.description: Number of times this config operation has been attempted.

audit_ip_address.description: Specifies the IP address (IPv4/IPv6) which is used to track the operation for audit logging purposes.

audit_user.description: Specifies the user which is used to track the operation for audit logging purposes.

creation_time.description: Seconds since the epoch when the config operation row was created.

destination_type.description: 'url': URL to a file, e.g. a file-server on the network or on a USB drive. 'startupConfig': startup config. 'runningConfig': running config. 'checkpoint': checkpoint.

destination_url_or_checkpoint_name.description: The URL for the destination configuration or checkpoint name. This field is empty unless the destination type is either 'url' or 'checkpoint'.

end_time.description: Seconds since the epoch when the copy operation 'state' became 'successful' or 'failed'.

exported_config_format.description: 'cli': command line interface with 'show running' format. 'json': JavaScript Object Notation.

failure_state.description: 'attemptsExceeded': maximum number of unsuccessful attempts for this configuration copy operation exceeded. 'authenticationFailed': user/pass combination failed. 'badFilename': bad filename/path/permissions. 'busy': there is another configuration copy operation running. Retry later. 'configChanged': the configuration changed while the copy operation was in progress. 'invalidConfig': source config is invalid. 'invalidRequest': the request contains an invalid parameter combination. 'invalidURL': provided URL is invalid. 'systemNotReady': system is not ready to copy configuration. 'timeout': the network may be overloaded, or the remote file server may not be responding. 'duplicateCheckpoint': there is a checkpoint with the same configuration in it 'checkpointNotFound': the specified checkpoint does not exist 'diskFull': file system is full, can not save operation results 'invalidIOResult': system I/O error 'resourcesFailed': external resources failure or busy, can not execute operation. 'insufficientSystemMemory': insufficient free system memory available to execute the operation. 'unknown': failure unknown.

last_config_change_timestamp.description: Timestamp of the latest configuration change obtained by the user.

operation.description: 'copy': copy a configuration from a source to a destination. 'validate': validate a configuration.             Validation only applies to configuration in CLI format. JSON configuration is copied as-is. 'read': read a configuration from source. 'diff': compares configurations between source and destination. 'hash': generate hash value from specific config or checkpoint 'timer': start checkpoint auto time counter (ARM). 'confirm': checkpoint auto confirm command (ACK). 'lock': requests a lock for a legacy config operation.

operation_index.description:
Reference Resource: [Config_Operation](#/Config_Operation)
Unique copy operation index. If the requester is 'snmp', this value is expected to match its corresponding arubaWiredConfigurationCopyIndex value.

range_end_time.description: End time to use for read specfic configurations.

range_start_time.description: Start time to use for read specfic configurations

requester.description:
Reference Resource: [Config_Operation](#/Config_Operation)
'autoCheckpoint': config checkpoint auto save process 'boot': boot process daemon. 'checkpoint': automatic configuration checkpoint. 'cli': command line interface. 'cmf': configuration migration framework. 'issu': ISSU process daemon 'mgmtmd': management module daemon. 'modules': line card management daemon 'rest': REST server. 'snmp': SNMP via the ARUBAWIRED CONFIG MIB. 'vsf': virtual switching and forwarding daemon. 'vsx': virtual switching extension daemon. 'vsxSwUpgrade': virtual switching extension software upgrade daemon. 'vsxSync': virtual switching extension configuration synchronization daemon. 'ztp': zero-touch provisioning daemon.

requester_index.description:
Reference Resource: [Config_Operation](#/Config_Operation)
unique identifier for the requester of the configuration operation

source_format.description: 'full': the entire configuration in CLI or JSON format. 'diff': the entire configuration in CLI format plus added/removed lines.

source_type.description: 'url': URL to a file, e.g. a file-server on the network or on a USB drive.        When operation is 'validate' this is an internal URL used for dry run. 'startupConfig': startup config. 'runningConfig': running config. 'checkpoint': checkpoint.

source_url_or_checkpoint_name.description: The URL for the source configuration or checkpoint name. This field is empty unless the source type is either 'url' or 'checkpoint'.

start_time.description: Seconds since the epoch when the copy operation 'state' became 'running'.

state.description: 'notReady': not ready to be serviced. Only request 'snmp' entries should ever be 'notReady'. Other requesters should have all required information at the time they create the config operation request. 'ready': ready to be serviced. 'running': copy operation is running. 'background': copy operation is not currently running but its waiting for an event. 'successful': copy operation was successful. 'failed': copy operation failed. See the failure state for more details.

user_name.description: Specifies the username used to authenticate with a remote server in order to download or upload the configuration.

user_password.description: Specifies the password used to authenticate with a remote server in order to download or upload the configuration.

vrf_name.description: Specifies the vrf used to connect to the remote server in order to download or upload the configuration.

parameters.name: selector
parameters.description: Select configuration, status and/or statistics. Default is all categories.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Filter rows by attribute values.  Format: attribute:value

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Count the number of rows found.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: Entity-tag value for representation comparison (see RFC 7232 - Conditional Requests - section 3.2)
